item.title: And then they throw in some Celtic languages and yoink bits …
item.author: Thea O'Ryan Files (@theaoryanfiles.bsky.social)
item.description:
And then they throw in some Celtic languages and yoink bits of languages from around the world along the way. The result: a language where there are usually about 10 different ways to say something, but when it comes to writing, you sit at your desk for 20 minutes trying to think of one 🤣
#amwriting
